title: Public Alert No. 22/2025 –Counterfeit Herceptin® 600mg/5ml in Vial (Trastuzumab Solution for Injection) found in Ghana
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Herceptin 600mg/5ml (trastuzumab) injection, batch A8519, circulating in Ghana but reportedly bought in Nigeria. The batch is not a valid Roche batch; packaging and seals differ. It may lack active ingredient, risking ineffective cancer treatment.
